sections.heading: On the list.
sections.intro: A short record of films and series I have enjoyed recently. These are brief introductions rather than reviews, and each title links to an official page.

items.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
items.meta: Film · Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton
items.text: Peter Parker continues protecting New York after the world has forgotten his identity. As he watches people from his former life move on, changes in his own powers coincide with a new threat to the city.

items.title: Thunderbolts*
items.text: Yelena Belova and a group of other outsiders are drawn together by a trap laid by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine. Their attempt to survive forces them to reckon with their histories and decide whether they can work together.

items.title: The Passengers of the Night
items.meta: Film · Les Passagers de la nuit · Directed by Mikhaël Hers
items.text: In 1980s Paris, Elisabeth finds work on a late-night radio programme while raising her two teenagers after a separation. There she meets Talulah, a young woman she welcomes into the family’s home.

items.title: Stranger Things
items.meta: Series · Created by the Duffer Brothers
items.text: The disappearance of a boy in Hawkins draws his friends and family into a mystery involving secret experiments, supernatural forces, and a girl with unusual powers.

items.title: Hawkeye
items.text: Set in post-Blip New York at Christmas, Clint Barton’s attempt to return to his family is interrupted by a threat from his past and an uneasy partnership with the young archer Kate Bishop.
